scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Fresh Water Aquaculture Farms
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years
Applicant must be interested in freshwater fish or prawn farming
benefits_summary: Subsidies for construction/renovation (25% up to ₹2  lakh per hectare), equipment (50% up to ₹60 000 per hectare per year) and feed (25% up to ₹50 000 per hectare per year) for freshwater aquaculture farms.
